item.title: Version 1.3.0
item.description:
Settings now follow the way your files move.

  • see the whole file flow at once
    Drag in, transform, and drag out settings now live together along one path, so it is easier to understand what happens at each step.
  • choose shelf locations with less clutter
    Left, Notch, and Right are now one compact control, with Dock snapping directly below.
  • keep the original settings if you want them
    Choose Ugly under General to bring back the old forms. Beautiful is the default, and both layouts edit the same preferences.
